message.content:
The founder of Buddhism was **Siddhārtha Gautama**, who later became known as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”). He was born into a royal family in what is now **Lumbini, Nepal** (in the ancient kingdom of Kapilavastu, near the modern India–Nepal border) around the mid‑6th century BCE.

Buddhism originated in **ancient India**, specifically in the northeastern part of the Indian subcontinent (the region that includes present‑day Nepal and northern India). It began as a reform movement within the broader spiritual traditions of the time, eventually spreading across Asia and beyond.
